content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-p05-10otfnze/report.rdl

Default the date range to the last 30 days: DateFrom 30 days ago, DateTo today.

I set the defaults on the two date parameters. The report now opens with DateFrom = 30 days before today and DateTo = today, both written as `yyyy-MM-dd` text.

- **DateFrom:** `=Format(DateAdd("d", -30, Today()), "yyyy-MM-dd")`
- **DateTo:** `=Format(Today(), "yyyy-MM-dd")`

The defaults are evaluated when the report runs, so they stay current each day. Nothing else in the report was changed.

Two things to be aware of:

- **The defaults don't filter the data yet.** DataSet1 has no query parameters bound to DateFrom or DateTo, so the fleet table and chart still return all dates. Wiring them in would mean adding a DAX filter on `Usage[ReportDate]` that uses the parameters. I haven't done that because you asked only for the defaults. I can add it if you want.
- **The DateFrom and DateTo parameters are typed as String.** The validator flags this because string comparison against a date column will mismatch. Switching them to DateTime would be the fix, and I'd suggest doing it together with the filter above. I left the type alone.

The validator also reports an orphaned `Utilization` field in DataSet1 that the DAX doesn't return, and two unused data sources (LegacySQL and ScratchPowerQuery). These predate this change and I didn't touch them.
